data.content_ref: inline:Introduce a graded attack relation with a deterministically ordered threshold sweep: each attack edge carries strength in [0,1]; run the grounded fixpoint at k fixed thresholds in ascending order and accept a conjecture iff it is IN in every pass. The sweep order is part of the spec, so the result is deterministic and cost is k×polynomial; reinstatement is re-verified per threshold and remains derived. The open critique is that threshold choice is arbitrary and the intersection can be strictly less decisive than single-threshold grounded.
